column1: # shell components: kind  name  key  description  flags (see lib/components.sh)
mode    commands    -       commands on PATH, then zsh builtins and reserved words                  default
mode    aliases     -       aliases (regular, global, suffix) and their expansions                   -
mode    functions   -       functions and their files (completion functions with the toggle)         -
mode    params      -       parameters and the environment, with their values                        -
toggle  completion  alt-1   functions: completion functions (_*) too                                 -
toggle  exported    alt-2   params: exported ones only                                               -
toggle  reveal      alt-3   params: show the values of exported secrets (FZX_SHELL_SECRETS)          -
action  edit        ctrl-e  functions: the file at the definition; commands: a script, in $EDITOR    foreground
action  help        alt-n   the tldr or man page in the pager (an alias: its command's; a builtin: zshbuiltins)  foreground
action  value       alt-y   params: copy the values (masked ones skipped)                            silent,notify
action  copy        ctrl-y  copy the names                                                          silent,builtin
